functions.name: batch-export-translations

includeVariableInfo.description: Include variable notes; omission uses provider default.

allowOutsideTranslation.description: Bypass the In Translation lifecycle requirement; default false.

FunctionInput_paligo_batchexporttranslat.description: Documents, languages, and options for one aggregate XLIFF translation export.

id.description: Aggregate export job ID; does not establish per-document success.

message.description: Aggregate progress message, not structured item outcomes.

FunctionOutput_paligo_batchexporttransla.description: Aggregate translation export job metadata, without individual document outcomes.

Use `get-translation-export` for progress. Preview is invalid for publications. Requires administrator access; do not replay uncertain starts blindly.

functions.name: batch-import-translations
functions.description: Start one translation import job from an XLIFF file for 2–20 documents. Returns aggregate job metadata rather than individual document outcomes.

text.description: Ordinary Unicode XLIFF file content, not base64 or multipart.

fileName.description: XLIFF basename ending in .xlf or .xliff, without directory components.

items.description: Document ID expressed as decimal digits.

FunctionInput_paligo_batchimporttranslat.description: One XLIFF file and settings for an aggregate translation import into 2–20 documents.

status.description: Aggregate current provider state, not per-document success.

message.description: Aggregate progress message; not structured item outcomes.

FunctionOutput_paligo_batchimporttransla.description: Aggregate translation import job metadata, without individual document outcomes.

tags.instructions: Use `import-translations` for one document or a PO file. Supply at most 20 document IDs and one XLIFF file as ordinary text. honorStatus=false may overwrite completed translations. Use `get-translation-import` afterwards. Requires administrator access; do not replay an uncertain start blindly.

functions.name: cancel-production

cancelled.description: Paligo acknowledged successful cancellation, not rollback of prior side effects.

tags.instructions: Obtain the production ID from `list-productions`, `get-production` or `create-production`. Cancellation aborts running work or prevents pending work; it does not delete a production record or promise rollback of published artifacts. Requires administrator access.

functions.name: create-assignment

type.description: Assignment category; translationreview means translation review.

endAt.description: End instant with explicit offset, not before startAt; whole-second precision only.

message.description: Optional ordinary-text message; omission uses the provider default, and empty text is sent unchanged.

startAt.description: Start instant with explicit offset; must be exactly representable in whole Unix seconds.

language.description: Paligo language code for the assignment.

userIds.description: Opaque user IDs; omitted means no directly assigned users.

groupIds.description: Opaque assignment-group IDs; omitted means no assigned groups.

userIds.description: Opaque user IDs; omitted means no directly assigned users.

groupIds.description: Opaque assignment-group IDs; omitted means no assigned groups.

assignees.description: Complete initial assignee selection; at least one nonempty user or group list is required.

functions.name: create-document
functions.description: Create a document component or publication from XML, with an optional parent folder and custom attributes.

xml.description: Original XML text for the new document; sent without markup rewriting.

tags.instructions: Use `list-folders` for a parent folder ID, or omit it to create in root Documents. Provide original XML, not encoded text. Use `create-fork` afterward to represent an existing document inside another document structure; creating a document does not itself insert that structural link.

functions.name: create-folder
functions.description: Create a folder inside a specified parent or root Documents.

tags.instructions: Use `list-folders` to obtain a parent folder ID. Omit the parent to create in root Documents. This creates a new folder, not an association to an existing one; replay can create a second folder.

functions.name: create-fork
functions.description: Create a representation of an existing document inside a parent fork or root document structure.

parentId.description: Opaque parent fork ID, or document ID for a top-level placement.

Inserting at a position shifts subsequent forks. This creates a structural representation, not a new underlying document.

functions.name: create-taxonomy

functions.name: update-assignment

groupIds.description: Replacement assigned group IDs; omitted within assignees means none.

userIds.description: Replacement directly assigned user IDs; at least one user is required for this selection.
